milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task. The player must navigate to within 5 blocks of the jack_o_lantern (at spawn-relative [7, 2, 7] on a fence post pedestal) and face toward it within 45°. max_distance reduced from 16 to 5 to prevent trivial completion at spawn (~10.1 blocks away), ensuring the player must walk at least ~5 blocks. facing_tolerance reduced from 60° to 45° to require genuine visual focus on the target. Sandbox exploration confirmed the agent reached the jack_o_lantern within 20 steps, validating achievability.
